identity.title: ALMA view of the circumstellar environment of the post-common-envelope-evolution binary system HD 101584

paper_type_evidence.quote: We used ALMA observations of the [12] CO, [13] CO, and C [18] O _J_ = 2–1 lines and the 1.3 mm continuum to determine the morphology, kinematics, masses, and energetics of the circumstellar environment.

evidence.quote: they estimated a (present-day) mass of ≈ 0.6 _M_ ⊙, a luminosity of ≈ 4000 _L_ ⊙, and a distance of ≈ 0.7 kpc.

question.value: What are the morphology, kinematics, masses and energetics of the circumstellar environment of the post-AGB binary HD 101584, and does it match common-envelope scenarios?

evidence.quote: We study the circumstellar evolution of the binary HD101584, consisting of a post-AGB star and a low-mass companion, which is most likely a post-common-envelope-evolution system.
This Letter makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00248.S.

findings_qualitative.value: Bipolar hour-glass structure seen almost pole-on, formed by a jet with peak velocity ≈150 km/s
